summary.result: The results obtained revealed the variables that affect the inside air humidity through a sensitivity analysis graph.
summary.background: A model was developed using Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA), to accurately predict the air humidity inside an experimental greenhouse located in Daegu (latitude $35.53^{\circ}N$ , longitude $128.36^{\circ}E$ , and altitude 48 m), South Korea.
summary.method: The Nash-Sutcliff Model Efficiency Coefficient (NSE) was used to analyze the difference between the experimental and the simulated results, in order to determine the predictive power of the ANN software.
